title: The Colour of Magic
author: Terry Pratchett
summary: The first Discworld novel follows Rincewind, a cowardly failed wizard, who is hired to guide the first tourist the flat world has ever seen. The pair stumble through danger, gods and dragons across a flat world carried on the back of a turtle.
readIf: you want a silly, quick, joke-packed fantasy parody and enjoy episodes more than a single plot.
skipIf: you want a polished story, since this early book is more a string of gags and wandered into by later ones improving.

pairings.reason: A later Discworld novel with a tighter plot and sharper characters, often a better entry point.
Another quick, absurdist comedy that sends hapless characters through a ridiculous universe.
The classic quest story that this book playfully pokes at.
